.comment: Starter config. Any key that starts with .comment is a note for you: envtally ignores it, and you can delete or add them anywhere.
1. Replace the example project, app and URLs below with your own.
3. Run: envtally check             (calls every URL and reports)
Need auth headers, an app without a version endpoint (Jenkins, ...) or your own app type?
Run: envtally init --example full --print   to see a config with all of those explained.
profile = the app type used by every app that does not set its own.
A profile says which paths to call and how to read the version. Built in:

.comment-envOrder: The order envs are shown in. Envs not listed come after, alphabetically.

.comment: The layout is: project -> apps -> envs -> instance URLs. All names are yours to choose.
envtally calls every instance URL of an app/env and compares the versions they report:
all the same = IN SYNC, different = DRIFT, any instance not answering = DOWN.
Each env takes one URL, or a list when the env runs several instances.
Give the base URL only. The profile adds the path, e.g. /actuator/health.
